gloss: to master; to reach the extreme

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {極|きわ}めていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to master, to carry to perfection
definitions.explanation: To pursue something to the highest possible level; to achieve complete mastery of a skill, art, or discipline.

definitions.gloss: to reach the extreme of, to be extremely
definitions.explanation: To reach the utmost degree of a state or condition. Often used in the form を{極|きわ}める to express reaching the peak of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{剣術|けんじゅつ}→剣術：20194_kenjutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極|きわ}めた⟦{達人|たつじん}→達人：14378_tatsujin⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a master who has perfected the art of swordsmanship.

examples.japanese: ひとつ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極|きわ}める⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{年月|ねんげつ}→年月：00310_nengetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes many years to master a single field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極|きわ}めた⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧。
⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極|きわ}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: It is in a state of utter chaos.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{宮殿|きゅうでん}→宮殿：12285_kyuuden⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{壮麗|そうれい}→壮麗：12151_sourei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極|きわ}め、⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{圧倒|あっとう}した→圧倒する：17122_attousuru⟧。
examples.english: The palace was magnificent to the extreme, overwhelming all who visited.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 (to master) takes a direct object with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極|きわ}める (to master a technique). Sense 2 (to reach the extreme) also uses ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極|きわ}める (to reach the height of luxury). The pattern 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極|きわ}める is characteristic and appears in literary and formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極|きわ}める: to master one's path/craft
- ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極|きわ}める: to reach the height of luxury
- ⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極|きわ}める: to be in utter chaos
- ⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{極|きわ}める: to perfect a technique

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{究|きわ}める→究める：15359_kiwameru⟧: to investigate thoroughly (different kanji, focuses on research/inquiry)
- ⟦{極|きわ}み→極み：13140_kiwami⟧: the extreme, the peak (noun form)
